title: Make the case
open: You've got light in that tablet. Show me why the twins log was unjustified — and what you can honestly say about the unlabeled target.

clearance.title: Field clearance earned
lines: That's a case I can take. Appearance was not identity. Brightness was not distance. The unlabeled target stayed inside the light you actually recorded.
Painted Badlands is still closed. This basin taught you to stop talking when the evidence stops. Keep that.

moreEvidence.title: More evidence needed
moreEvidence.lead: Not a restart. The notes that hold stay in the tablet. The case still has a hole. Go get the missing line — I will not hand you an answer key.

claims.wren: The inherited log treated two white stars as twins because they looked alike. Show me the notes that make that claim unjustified.
claims.retry: Appearance was the first observation. Which notes actually break the nickname?

why.DS-06: The floor rock is a different clock. It doesn't break the twins nickname.
why.DS-08: Origin lines don't tell me why those two white stars weren't the same light.

claims.need: I still need the comparison that appearance was not enough.
claims.ok: They looked alike. The traces did not. That's why the nickname fails.
claims.overclaim: That extra card doesn't answer the twins log. Drop what isn't about those two lights.

claims.wren: Two cairn stars looked about equally bright. What notes show that brightness was not distance?
claims.retry: Don't tell me a rule. Show me the baseline you walked.

why.DS-02: Peak wavelength is temperature evidence, not a walked baseline.
why.DS-07: Moved galaxy lines are a different pattern.

claims.need: I still need the cairn comparison — equal look, different shift.
claims.ok: Same apparent brightness, only one shifted with the baseline. Distance is not a brightness nickname.
claims.overclaim: Color folklore and galaxy shift don't stand in for the rim walk.

claims.wren: The unlabeled envelope. What can you honestly conclude — and what has to stay unknown?
claims.retry: Pin the notes you actually recorded. Leave the present-tense story off.

why.DS-05: Mass branches other stars. It doesn't name this unlabeled target.

claims.need: I still need the bounded envelope — observed, inferred, and a refused sentence.
claims.ok: That's inside the light you have. The rest stays unknown.
claims.overclaim: A complete life story isn't in that envelope. Drop the extra card.

claims.wren: The poster said the distant outburst is happening now. Which notes refuse that?
claims.retry: Looking farther can mean seeing earlier. Which tablet notes actually say that?

why.DS-01: The twins traces don't time a distant outburst.
why.DS-06: The floor rock is material history, not lookback for that poster.

claims.need: I still need the lookback note that the poster is not tonight's news.
claims.ok: The nearby star can change later tonight. The distant plate cannot tell you what is happening there now.
claims.overclaim: Keep the notes about light travel. Drop the ones that don't belong on this claim.
